statements.statement: The patient has a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary arteries
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
A 48-hour Holter monitoring study (CPT 93226) was billed
The claim was denied with reason code CO-22
The denial reason is that care may be covered by another payer per coordination of benefits regulations
The insurer is the secondary payer
